chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
"When that occurs, you will be closer to being increased [in rank/wealth] than you are to being decreased."

key_terms.أَقْرَبَ: closer (indicating probability or proximity in time/state)
key_terms.تُزَادُوا: to be increased (in rank, wealth, or status)
key_terms.تُنْقَصُوا: to be decreased (in rank, wealth, or status)

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean when he says we are closer to being increased than decreased?
ai.summary: Reported by the prominent companion Zurarah from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), this hadith utilizes the concept of 'al-Ziyadat' (additions/increases) to assure believers of spiritual and material growth rather than loss, contingent upon specific divine conditions. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the dynamic nature of divine favor, where adherence to covenant ensures an upward trajectory in one's standing with God.
